storeInfo.tagline: Authentic Wood-Fired Pizza & Local Tavern Favorites | Auténtica Pizza al Horno de Leña y Favoritos de Taberna
storeInfo.address: 39 South Main Street, West Hartford, CT

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Pan artesanal tostado con tomates frescos, albahaca, ajo y un toque de aceite de oliva virgen extra.
products.descriptionEn: Toasted artisan bread topped with fresh tomatoes, basil, garlic, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

products.descriptionEs: Anillos de calamar ligeramente empanizados y fritos a la perfección, servidos con salsa marinara casera.
products.descriptionEn: Lightly breaded calamari rings fried to perfection, served with our house-made marinara sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Nuestra pizza insignia con mozzarella fresca, salsa de tomate orgánico y albahaca, cortada con precisión para una experiencia impecable.
products.descriptionEn: Our signature pizza with fresh mozzarella, organic tomato sauce, and basil, precision-cut for a flawless dining experience.

products.descriptionEs: Base blanca con queso mozzarella, cubierta con prosciutto di Parma curado y rúcula fresca con un toque de reducción balsámica.
products.descriptionEn: White base with mozzarella, topped with cured Prosciutto di Parma and fresh arugula with a balsamic glaze drizzle.

products.nameEs: Lasaña de Carne a la Boloñesa
products.descriptionEs: Capas de pasta fresca, carne de res molida de alta calidad, queso ricotta y nuestra salsa boloñesa cocinada a fuego lento.
products.descriptionEn: Layers of fresh pasta, premium ground beef, ricotta cheese, and our slow-simmered bolognese sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Limonada fresca hecha en casa con un toque floral de lavanda orgánica.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh house-made lemonade with a floral touch of organic lavender.

products.nameEs: Alitas de Pollo al Horno de Leña
products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo jugosas marinadas en hierbas, asadas en horno de leña y servidas con salsa picante de la casa y aderezo de queso azul.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy herb-marinated chicken wings roasted in our wood-fired oven, served with house hot sauce and blue cheese dressing.

products.descriptionEs: Albóndigas caseras de res y cerdo en salsa marinara, cubiertas con queso mozzarella fundido y albahaca fresca.
products.descriptionEn: Homemade beef and pork meatballs in rich marinara, topped with melted mozzarella cheese and fresh basil.

products.descriptionEs: Polenta suave y cremosa coronada con salteño de setas silvestres, ajo, vino blanco y queso parmesano añejo.
products.descriptionEn: Soft and creamy polenta topped with a savory sauté of wild mushrooms, garlic, white wine, and aged parmesan cheese.

products.descriptionEs: Queso burrata cremoso servido con tomates heirloom de la granja, reducción de balsámico añejo y pesto de albahaca.
products.descriptionEn: Creamy burrata cheese served with farm-fresh heirloom tomatoes, aged balsamic reduction, and house basil pesto.
Fresh coastal mussels sautéed with garlic, shallots, white wine, butter, and a touch of red pepper flakes.

products.descriptionEs: Flores de calabacín crujientes rellenas de requesón cremoso y hierbas finas, fritas a la perfección dorada.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy zucchini blossoms stuffed with creamy ricotta and fine herbs, fried to a golden perfection.

products.nameEs: Pan de Ajo con Queso de Cabra
products.descriptionEs: Pan rústico de masa madre untado con mantequilla de ajo asado, queso de cabra fundido y miel de lavanda local.
products.descriptionEn: Rustic sourdough bread spread with roasted garlic butter, melted goat cheese, and local lavender honey.

products.descriptionEs: Jugosa carne de res Angus con queso cheddar de Vermont, tocino crujiente, cebollas caramelizadas y salsa especial en brioche.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy Angus beef patty with Vermont cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, caramelized onions, and special sauce on a brioche bun.

products.nameEs: Pechuga de Pollo al Limón y Hierbas
products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo tierna a la parrilla con salsa de limón, alcaparras y vino blanco, acompañada de puré de patatas al ajo.
products.descriptionEn: Tender grilled chicken breast with a lemon, caper, and white wine sauce, served with garlic mashed potatoes.

products.nameEs: Costillas de Cerdo Barbacoa al Horno
products.descriptionEs: Costillas de cerdo tiernas glaseadas con salsa barbacoa artesanal de la casa, servidas con papas fritas rústicas.
products.descriptionEn: Tender baby back pork ribs glazed with our house artisan barbecue sauce, served with rustic French fries.

products.nameEs: Filete de Salmón a la Plancha
products.descriptionEs: Salmón fresco de Atlántico con costra de hierbas, salsa de mantequilla blanca y limón, acompañado de espárragos asados.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh Atlantic salmon with herb crust, lemon white butter sauce, served with roasted asparagus.

products.descriptionEs: Arroz arborio cremoso cocinado a fuego lento con setas mixtas, vino Marsala, aceite de trufa y queso parmesano.
products.descriptionEn: Creamy arborio rice slow-cooked with mixed mushrooms, Marsala wine, truffle oil, and parmesan cheese.

products.nameEs: Bistec a la Parrilla con Mantequilla de Hierbas
products.nameEn: Grilled Ribeye Steak with Herb Butter
products.descriptionEn: Juicy 12 oz grilled ribeye steak topped with garlic herb butter, served with a baked potato.
Fior di latte mozzarella base, sautéed wild mushrooms, white truffle oil, and pecorino romano cheese.
San Marzano tomato sauce, spicy Italian sausage, roasted peppers, red onion, and mozzarella cheese.

products.nameEn: Four Cheese Pizza with Hot Honey
products.descriptionEn: Mozzarella, gorgonzola, fontina, and goat cheese finished with a drizzle of infused hot honey.

products.nameEs: Pizza Blanca de Espinacas y Ricotta
products.descriptionEn: No tomato sauce. Fresh ricotta cheese, garlic wilted spinach, mozzarella, and garlic confit.
Wood-fired shredded chicken, BBQ sauce, red onion, fresh cilantro, and smoked provolone cheese.
Folded pizza dough baked in our wood-fired oven, stuffed with ham, ricotta, mozzarella, and side marinara.
Garlic-marinated shrimp, extra virgin olive oil, mozzarella, cherry tomatoes, and fresh parsley.
Freshly squeezed house lemonade infused with fresh raspberry puree and garden mint leaves.

products.nameEs: Té Helado de Durazno y Jengibre
products.descriptionEn: Freshly brewed black tea combined with sweet peach syrup and a zesty kick of fresh ginger.
The classic Italian aperitif featuring Aperol, sparkling Prosecco wine, club soda, and a fresh orange slice.
Draft craft IPA brewed right here in local Connecticut breweries with vibrant citrus and floral hop notes.
Glass of Italian red wine from the Tuscany region, featuring ripe cherry notes and subtle spice.
Vintage-style artisan root beer sweetened with pure cane sugar and topped with a rich, creamy foam.
Refreshing non-alcoholic drink featuring fresh blueberries, mint, lime, cane sugar, and club soda.
Rich and aromatic Italian espresso shot brewed from dark-roasted artisan beans.

products.nameEs: Agua Mineral San Pellegrino con Gas
products.descriptionEn: Bottle of naturally sparkling Italian mineral water, perfect for cleansing the palate between meals.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, pregunte a nuestro personal por las opciones marcadas en el menú.
faqs.aEn: Yes, please ask our staff for items marked on the menu.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación y reservaciones por teléfono.
